citations.quote:
[name="帕蒂亚"]没办法，他们不是战士出身，接受训练的时间也不长，能做到这种程度已经很不错了。
[character(name="avg_300_phenxi_1#2$1")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]帕蒂亚，不装了？
[character(name="avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]如果你不挡我的路，我本来不打算和你纠缠。
[character(name="avg_npc_357_1#4$1")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]……
[character(name="avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]看在过去的分上，奉劝你一句。
[name="菲亚梅塔"]无论你碰到了什么人，听了谁的话，打算做什么——现在收手，还来得及。
[character(name="avg_npc_357_1#6$1")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]听了谁的话？
[name="帕蒂亚"]菲亚梅塔，你又是在听谁的话？
[character(name="avg_300_phenxi_1#2$1")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]不要与教皇厅为敌，帕蒂亚。
[character(name="avg_npc_357_1#3$1")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]如果说，我的目的就是与教皇厅为敌呢？
[character(name="avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]……帕蒂亚，我现在还可以当做没听过这句话。
[character(name="avg_npc_357_1#2$1")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]……菲亚梅塔，你还是和以前一样……
[character(name="avg_npc_357_1#5$1")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]只是为了一点点情谊……你就愿意百般维护。
[character(name="avg_npc_357_1#3$1")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]可惜，我和以前不一样了。
[character(name="avg_npc_357_1#3$1")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]你可以当做没听过，我却不能当做没说过。

[name="菲亚梅塔"]真是的，连喘口气的时间都不给吗？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowshot", volume=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrow", volume=1, loop=false, channel="s1",delay=0.1)]
[Delay(time=0.3)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowtarget", volume=0.7, loop=false, channel="s3")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowtarget", volume=0.6, loop=false, channel="s4",delay=0.2)]
[CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=25,ystrength=25, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255,g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$bodyfalldown1", volume=1)]
[charslot(duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#6$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]抓紧换弹，菲亚梅塔。
[name="帕蒂亚"]你补充弹药的空当，我会顶上你的位置。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]那么惊讶干嘛？我们之前不是打过几架，要忘记你的战斗方式可不容易。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]谢了。
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_crowdrun",volume=0.6)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, style = "slider", inverse = true, fadetime=1.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1805_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="堕天使"]喂喂，莫斯提马，能不能给我解释下，刚刚到底发生了什么？
[name="堕天使"]刚刚我踹飞一只怪物的时候，不小心踩上了那些异色的投影，结果……
[CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=25,ystrength=25, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="堕天使"]*拉特兰粗口*，结果我的靴子它——凭空长出了光环？！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#3$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]那是育婴圣堂的投影，如果不想被转化成什么自己也不理解的东西，就别碰到它！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1795_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="离群萨科塔"]躲能躲到哪里去……
[name="离群萨科塔"]这投影蔓延得太快，还没等那些怪物的大部队走到，我们就要先被它赶出圣马尔索区了……
[name="离群萨科塔"]到时候根本没人能留下来防守！
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_gen_transmissionget",volume=0.6)]
[interlude(maskid = "group_interclude_vertical_common" ,size = "290,760",tsfrom="0,1", tsto ="1,1",tsduration = 0.5, switch = true, style = 0,offset = "-250,0", channel = 3)]
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true, type = 3, slot = "m", pfrom = "-250,0", pto="-250,0", name = "avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1", duration = 0)]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]我们在夕辉礼拜堂的那台大管风琴里塞了炸药，从莱塔尼亚来的朋友在上面留了自动引燃的术式。
[name="菲亚梅塔"]哪怕我们的人都撤了，应该也能炸那些怪物个措手不及。
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]全城哀悼仪式上用来奏哀歌的那台？
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = true)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#1$1",focus="n")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]就是那台。
[interlude(channel = 3, switch = false)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="r")]
[name="莫斯提马"]挺好。它听了几百年的祈祷和哀悼，是时候该听点热闹的了。
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[interlude(channel = 3, clear = true)]
[charslot]
[Delay(time=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, style = "slider", inverse = true, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$pistol", volume=0.9)]
[PlaySound(key="$pistol", volume=0.9, loop=false, channel="shot",delay=0.4)]
[CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=30,ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_cartridgepopup", volume=0.9)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]撤吧，帕蒂亚，我们刚抛在地上的弹壳都已经长出光环了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]伊卡莱西亚区的启示石塔和米迦莱昂区的公证所都已经失守，圣马尔索区的夕辉礼拜堂就是到达大教堂前的最后一站了。
[name="帕蒂亚"]如果我们留下的炸药还阻止不了那支队伍，我们就真的无计可施了。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_runstop", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.7)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]哈，如果费德里科和安多恩的说法靠谱，那支队伍的终点真的就是大教堂……倒还不至于说已经山穷水尽哦。
[name="莫斯提马"]我做了那么长时间的万国信使，在赶路方面还算有经验。
[multiline(name="莫斯提马")]如果阻止不了赶路的人，那么……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="莫斯提马")]直接把终点变没了不就好了？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#2$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]喂喂，莫斯提马，炸一台管风琴和把大教堂整个炸掉还是有区别的！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]连靴子都和萨科塔一样长光环了，我觉得管风琴和大教堂的差别也没那么大。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]好吧，你说得没错。既然拦不住也杀不死那只巨大的怪物，我们起码可以想办法把路变没，让她永远无法到达终点。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]你和我说的真的是一回事？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]走，撤去大教堂前的广场！

[name="菲亚梅塔"]忘记了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]你那边怎么样？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="菲亚梅塔")]好消息，炸弹已经就位。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="菲亚梅塔")]坏消息，我怕它们的威力不足以摧毁全部的锁定装置，把剩下的榴弹也都安上去了……
[name="菲亚梅塔"]所以，我现在已经没有任何弹药去对付这些怪物了。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_snarl_1", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="蒙恩的生物A"]（光环急速闪烁）
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="蒙恩的生物B"]（连续不断的祷告声）
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]喂，菲亚梅塔，启动吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]等等，蕾缪安那边还没有消息，如果锁定装置没能及时解除防护，我们所有的炸药就都浪费了……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="h")]
[StopSound(channel="h", fadetime=6)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]爆破倒计时，一分钟！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]你？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
计时器的声音从菲亚梅塔的手中传出，蒙恩的生物纷纷停下了祷告，他们像是预感到了会发生什么，发疯了似的向她扑了过来。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_monsterroar", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.7)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_wolflordclaw",volume=0.7)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowshot")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowtarget", volume=0.6,delay=0.3)]
[PlaySound(key="$bodyfalldown2", volume=1,delay=0.8)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_sandnmlfts", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_332_archet#6",focus="m")]
[name="席德佳"]……
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="bg_black",screenadapt="coverall")]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
席德佳摸向箭壶，里面已经空了。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="fs")]
[StopSound(channel="fs", fadetime=4.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[stopmusic(fadetime=1.5)]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]倒计时，五十秒！
[name="？？？"]抱歉，各位，希望我没有来迟！
[Dialog]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_electrcwhlchrrll",volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot]
[image(image="61_i19",screenadapt="coverall",fadetime=0)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$drift", volume=0.5)]
[PlayMusic(intro="$m_bat_act26side_intro", key="$m_bat_act26side_loop", volume=0.6)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
车轮急刹，在地面激荡起烟尘。车手拧转轮椅，右手在同一时间举起了铳，她的长发在空中肆意飞舞。
[name="莫斯提马"]时间刚刚好！
[name="蕾缪安"]菲亚梅塔，莫斯提马，我们的配合还是那么默契！
[name="蕾缪安"]哈哈，你俩肯定猜不到，从第七厅一路突围到这里，我把自己轮椅竞速射击赛的纪录突破了多少！
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="fs1")]
[StopSound(channel="fs1", fadetime=3)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]倒计时，四十秒！

contributions.description: 菲亚梅塔与帕蒂亚协同战斗。
